about_the_game:
Gargoyle Gatling is a co-op beat 'em up, where you play as up to four gargoyles in a 2.5D environment. The art style is inspired by both '90s cartoons and games, and a soundtrack that focuses on making each level feel unique.

The four main characters are:

Rocko, the slow but strong leader of the group.

Charlie, the fast and agile type who focuses on kicks.

Gizmit, the weird one who loves staying on the move at all times.

Sid, the tactical type who prefers to have his enemies pushed away at all times.

Use these four and their abilities to fight your way through a Prison, the Streets, a Casino, and an abandoned Mansion. Then, prepare yourself to face the Prisoner you accidentally released after an unfortunate plunge into the Underworld.

Remember to use every tool at your disposal, such as grabs, throws, dash attacks, and the various guns you will find throughout the environment. These guns range from assault rifles to giant crabs, so make sure you find which one suits your playstyle.

short_description: Gargoyle Gatling is a 4-player co-op beat em' up where you play as four gargoyles fighting their way through the underworld to stop the prisoner that they released. Grab, punch, kick, throw, and shoot your way through the denizens of hell one level at a time. With the occasional gambling break.
